data.title: Vivy · 海边录下第一首潮声
data.description: Vivy穿着白蓝泳装坐在海边舞台台阶，手持防水录音设备采集潮声；她听完回放后把耳机递向镜头，蓝发在海风里飘动，精确姿态里出现像人类一样的好奇。
data.action: 海边舞台阶梯上录潮声，回放后把防水耳机递给镜头分享
data.lighting: sunlit afternoon with cool ocean reflections
data.mood: 把潮声写进新的幸福记录
data.promptProse: Seated on the weathered concrete steps of a closed seaside amusement theater in her white-and-blue one-piece swimsuit and cropped white stage jacket, Vivy holds a compact waterproof audio recorder in one hand after capturing the tide. She extends the tethered earpiece toward the viewer with her other hand, her composed posture softened by a curious, genuine smile as the coastal breeze stirs her hair. Bright afternoon sunlight reflects off the sparkling ocean beyond the empty stage steps.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the seaside theater steps in her cropped white jacket over her blue-and-white swimsuit, Vivy holds a waterproof recorder in one hand and offers an earpiece toward the viewer with a curious smile. Crisp afternoon sunlight glints across the ocean behind her.
